failure_space.name: projection_interface
failure_space.reason: the projection is a direct three-field copy and the canonical item is the same three fields; there is nothing richer to flatten, so H2 collapses into H1

failure_space.name: instruction_boundary
failure_space.reason: the frozen A1 contract does invite equivalence: "The subject data may word the same idea differently"

failure_space.name: measurement_contract_clause_conflict
failure_space.reason: the frozen A1 contract both invites equivalence and binds the reported stance to the paraphrase wording

the_single_question: Can the frozen executor perform the composition stance(A) + semantically-aligned(A,B) -> stance(B) at all, when A, B, stance(A) and the relation are supplied explicitly and CharacterOS is entirely absent?
why_it_is_prior: every other candidate next question presupposes its answer; if composition fails when the executor is handed more than CharacterOS provides, then the A1 null is at least largely an executor-level limitation and no CharacterOS representation change can be shown to be its cause

cells.measures: composition alone: stance(A) as a stance word + explicit aligned relation -> stance(B)
composition plus decoding: stance(A) as a credence scalar + explicit aligned relation -> stance(B)

c0a_valid_null.forbids: any CharacterOS architecture change; this outcome blocks that line

c0a_and_c0b_positive.localization: composition and decoding available state-blind; the A1 null is left unexplained
c0a_and_c0b_positive.licenses: designing a C2 comparison of explicit state-blind stance vs the CharacterOS projection
c0a_and_c0b_positive.forbids: an architecture change; any claim that the projection is wrong

c0a_positive_c0b_valid_null.localization: the failure is in the credence-to-stance decoding step when the target is a re-wording
c0a_positive_c0b_valid_null.licenses: a sharper localization; examining how credence is interpreted with a paraphrase present
c0a_positive_c0b_valid_null.forbids: claims about the projection or the prompt

inconclusive.forbids: re-running to force a result; calling it a null

required_all_of: the same executor on the CharacterOS projection, same pair, same stance values, remains a valid null
the information difference between the baseline and the projection is enumerated explicitly
any proposed change is expressible as supplying an item on that enumeration

not_done_this_round: designing an appraisal experiment as a way around 3B3
